program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "gmidn": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "Lp":    (2.5, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Ln":    (2.5, 1.0, 3.0),
    "I6":    (28e-6, 18e-6, 32e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.8e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.0e-12),
    "rzf":   (2.5, 1.2, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = iref
    i1 = itail / 2
    I6 = p["I6"]
    gmid_n = p["gmidn"]
    gmid_p = 10.0

    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], itail, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["rzf"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "y", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = a1 * a2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m6.cgd
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * Cc + c1 * cout + Cc * cout))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2))
    if Rz > 1.0 / m6.gm:
        fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fz))
    pm = min(pm, 89.0) - 5.0
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + I6)
    slew = 0.75 * min(itail / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew * 0.5 + 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sth = 2 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sth) * 20.0   # flicker-dominated at 1 kHz (calibrated)
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / ((m1.gds + m3.gds) * max(m5.gds, 1e-12)) / 2)
    psrr = db(A0) + db((m6.gds + m7.gds) / m6.gds) - 2
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    pred = {
        "gain_db": db(A0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise,
        "psrr_db": psrr,
        "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, db(A0) + 10),
        "swing": swing,
        "polarity": 1,
        "vtail_margin": vtail - m5.vdsat,
    }
    return n, pred

events.topology: Two-stage Miller OTA, NMOS input, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS second stage, Rz nulling

events.reason: The checker flagged 'input' as forbidden I/O; the word appeared only in comments. Remove it, clean the bias vds, and raise pair gm/Id to 14 for UGBW margin (gm1 about 70 uS, so about 6 MHz with 1.8 pF
M5 tail is in triode (tail node 0.175 V), collapsing CMRR/PSRR. Raise input-pair gm/Id to lower Vgs, bias the tail mirror at higher gm/Id for lower Vdsat, and allow longer L for more gain to reach 91

Topology works and nearly everything passes. PSRR falls 12.6 dB short; sensitivities say it improves with longer Ln and Lp and lower gmidn. Longer Lp costs phase margin, so raise Cc and rzf to recover
